brief:
Middle East Eye published commentary arguing that anti-Muslim racism functions as a global system enabling mass violence. The piece identifies the ongoing conflict in Palestine as among the most severe manifestations of what the author describes as Islamophobic logic centered on characterizations of terrorism.

The commentary frames discrimination against Muslims as part of a broader international framework rather than isolated incidents. The analysis connects systemic anti-Muslim sentiment to how mass killing is rationalized and normalized in global discourse.

title: Analyst links anti-Muslim racism to normalization of mass killing
